name: @laticent/tavola
description: Live collaboration on one document, browser to browser: an invite link in the URL fragment, a knock-and-admit handshake, a roster gate that sends and accepts the document only for admitted members (and document edits only from members who may edit), a cap, and rejoin by token. The transport and the document are passed in, so the core has no dependencies; a Trystero adapter (public Nostr relays, then WebRTC) ships beside it.
